claims.quote: This is me making an offer to the Scottish Government. With us working together, there is no limit to what we can achieve for the Scottish people.
claims.statement: With the Scottish Government working together with the UK Government, there is no limit to what can be achieved for the Scottish people.

claims.quote: Devolution has done a great deal, but power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.
claims.statement: Devolution has done a great deal, but power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.

claims.statement: The Prime Minister's offer to the Scottish Government is a genuine one, and the Scotland Office is ready to work alongside them to make it happen.

claims.quote: Two governments, one goal - good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.
claims.statement: Two governments, one goal: good jobs and real opportunity in every corner of Scotland.
